verdict.rationale: Gmail's own support docs cover snoozing: an email leaves the inbox temporarily, returns to the top at a chosen time (tomorrow, next week, evening), and can be found with `in:snoozed`. Nothing in the pack shows follow-up reminders that resurface a thread when nobody replies, so only half the story is delivered. Missing for 10: documented follow-up/no-reply reminders (nudges), independent or hands-on corroboration of snooze behavior.
